store_tone: quiet late-night convenience store ambience, fluorescent light hum and a soft refrigerator compressor drone, no people, no music
chime: a convenience store automatic door opening with a bright two-note electronic entry chime
holo: a futuristic hologram display popping up, a bright digital shimmer
page: a single sheet of stiff paper picked up and held out: one crisp paper rustle, close, quiet room, no music
sip: one long loud slurp of hot coffee from a mug, close
blorp: a small squishy jelly blob landing on a plastic tray: a wet wobbly plop, cartoon, short
carton: a milk carton set down on a counter, a light cardboard tap
slide: a large wet slimy creature sliding across a smooth floor, a soft squelchy glide
droop: a soft cartoon deflating droop, a small sad wobble sound
carpet: a small rolled-up rug pushed and unrolling fast along a shop counter: a soft fabric whump and a short slide, close, no music
bot_roll: a tiny toy robot rolling along a counter on one rubber wheel: a small quiet electric motor whir, close, no music
spring_sign: a spring-loaded sign popping up out of a hat on a metal spring: one bright springy boing and a little wobble, cartoon, no music
